articles.summary: 37 FLIGHTS & ALMOST 7,000 RYANAIR PASSENGERS DELAYED BY GREEK ATC INCOMPETENCE Ryanair, Europe’s No.1 airline, today (Wed, 2 Sept), called on the EU Commission to urgently reform Europe’s failing ATC system after a Greek ATC equipment failure on Tues (1 Sept) caused widespread disruption across Greek airspace, delaying 37 Ryanair flights and impacting almost 7,000 Ryanair passengers, with delays of up to 3 hours.
